and M2 segments, basilar, and vertebral arteries) within 8 hours of symptom onset.

Device Name
Penumbra System 110 Aspiration Tubing
Indications for Use (Describe)
The Penumbra System is intended for use in the revascularization of patients with acute ischemic stroke secondary to
intracranial large vessel occlusive disease (within the internal carotid, middle cerebral – M1 and M2 segments, basilar,
and vertebral arteries) within 8 hours of symptom onset. The Reperfusion Catheters ACE 64 and ACE 68 are intended for
use in revascularization within the Internal Carotid Artery (ICA) within 8 hours of symptom onset.
